design.configuration_decision_definition: one endpoint decision atomically covers one candidate path and its complete observed endpoint-origin set; one root-scope decision covers every candidate path grouped below the selected root
design.deployment_efficiency_definition: avoided candidate rows per deployed OpenScope root
design.deployment_unit: one retained endpoint-prefix bundle containing its complete observed origin set
design.figure_2_display: arithmetic-mean curves only; no interval or range glyphs
design.figure_conflict_rate_scope: the same fixed denominator is used for both Figure 2 panels and Figure 3
design.invalid_definition: reference classifier returns Invalid for an announced endpoint route in the constructed deployment snapshot
design.multi_origin_rule: exact selection covers the complete observed endpoint-origin set
design.observed_definition: Invalid routes when sampled root ROAs, downstream ROAs, and S²-ROV policies are installed independently
design.observed_root_policy: independently active with the same marginal issuance rate as downstream exact ROAs

placement_root_scores.asrank-first: aggregate-origin ASN customer-cone order from CAIDA ASRank
placement_root_scores.degree-first: aggregate-origin ASN total degree in the same CAIDA graph
placement_root_scores.most-routes-first: eligible observed route-origin pairs below the root

design.placement_score_tie_break: independent fixed-seed random order within equal score groups; nested within each rollout
design.potential_definition: Invalid routes when every root ROA is active and the sampled downstream ROAs and S²-ROV policies are installed
design.remaining_definition: candidate lacks exact coverage and its root lacks OpenScope
design.scope_length_rule: each selected root uses the longest retained endpoint length below that root

figure_contract.archetype: Figure 2 uses one standalone shared legend above two vertically stacked panels; Figure 3 is one single-panel placement comparison
figure_contract.core_conclusion: OpenScope lowers both potential conflicts and mid-rollout conflicts realized when upstream ROAs are active before matching downstream ROAs, while selecting roots with more eligible observed routes accelerates the reduction.
figure_contract.hero_evidence: randomized replay means for Figure 2 conflicts at six S²-ROV policy levels and Figure 3 prioritization means at fixed 50% issuance

panel_map.heatmap_IPv4: random-order median over IPv4 candidate paths
panel_map.heatmap_IPv6: random-order median over IPv6 candidate paths
panel_map.observed_conflicts: independent root and downstream issuance share one rate
panel_map.openscope_placement: fixed 50% downstream ROA issuance; Route count, ASRank, AS degree, and Random root placement
panel_map.potential_conflicts: all root ROAs active; downstream ROA issuance varies

figure_contract.reviewer_risk: Observed denotes conflicts realized on the RRC00-derived routes inside the constructed joint rollout, not a historical Internet time series or an adoption estimate.
figure_contract.robustness: full q by s grid, family sensitivity, and four root-placement orders at fixed downstream issuance

root_scores.asrank-first: aggregate-origin ASN customer-cone order from CAIDA ASRank
root_scores.degree-first: aggregate-origin ASN total degree in the same CAIDA graph
root_scores.most-routes-first: eligible observed route-origin pairs below the root

openscope_placement.score_tie_break: independent fixed-seed random order within equal score groups; nested within each rollout
